correctness.rationale: For Rademacher signs the one-node Rayleigh-log output is deterministic and squared bias 4 log^2 cosh u. For uniform sphere, log(kappa cos²θ+sin²θ) has absolute Fourier expansion: mean log c and variance 2Li_2(t²), yielding M_S=16 log²cosh(u/2)+8Li_2(x). The difference/8 H(x) has derivative N(x)/(1-x²), with N increasing strictly from -1 to 2log2; H initially decreases, then increases to +infinity, so exactly one interior zero. Independently evaluated x*=0.77780968432523010353 and kappa*=254.07878454108627389 with high precision, and checked risk ordering. κ=1 both exact; sphere is normalized Gaussian direction, not ordinary Gaussian.
